en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a monumental statue of a man in 18th‑century military dress (Frederick the Great) standing atop a tall pedestal, holding a staff or cane. Below is a sculpted Prussian eagle and wreaths arranged around the base, all enclosed by a low white fence. Trees and buildings appear in the background. Printed caption text is at the bottom border, and inscriptions are visible on the pedestal.
